s: Din gag hassamuk lirshut harabbim ubo v' seipim: gag hassamuk lirshut harabbim veeno gaboah y' tepachim betziddo shebbirshut harabbim, ubishar tzedadin shebbechatzer hu gaboah asara — reshut hayyachid gemura hi min hattora. Veap al pi ken, hoil vehu betok asara lirshut harabbim verabbim mishtammeshim bo, shemmannichim bo kobaim vekelim qetannim — hare zeh kirshut harabbim, veasur lebaal haggag lehishtammesh bo mechatzer ad sheyyaaseh lo sullam qabua mechatzero, sheaz gilla dato shessilleq legag zeh mikkoach reshut harabbim ella noach lo lehishtammesh beatzmo alayv. Abal sullam aray — en kan silluq, shekkevan shessopo littol hassullam, kemo sheeno hu:
Veezehu sullam qabua? Kol sheqqeba[o] sham ben leshabbat ben lechol. Abal im qebao leshabbat velo lechol o lehepek, en zeh qabua:

Abal im mitztziddo shebbirshut harabbim hu gaboah, apillu sullam en tzarik. Abal im eno gaboah asara ben mitztzad reshut harabbim ben mitztzad hechatzer, ap al pi shehabbayit shebbetoko yesh bo y' tepachim — eno niqret al haggag reshut hayyachid, ella karmelit hu, veen sullam moil lo kelal:

Chatzer shennipretza bemilluah o beyater meeser ammot lirshut harabbim — meqom mechitztza niddon ketzidde reshut harabbim shehen karmelit, umuttar letaltel mittok hechatzer limqom hammechitztza, abal lo lirshut harabbim velo lirshut hayyachid velo lechutz led' ammot, mippene shettok hechatzer shennipretza lirshut harabbim naasa gam ken karmelit, shehare hu keqeren zavit hassemuka lirshut harabbim, shennitbaer besimman shm"h. Veim nipretza lekarmelit, hare hu karmelit middibre soperim (veap al pi ken, ap shehu reshut hayyachid min hattora, muttar letaltel mimmennu lekarmelit gemura mittaam shennitbaer besimman shm"v). Abal im happirtza hi pachot meeser veenah bemilluah — enah oseret, mippene shehi kepetach:

Im nipretza beqeren zavit mammash, dehaynu shehappirtza topeset mishte ruchoteha etzel hazzaviyyot, apillu bepachot meeser asur, lepi sheen derek laasot petach beqeren zavit. Veken bet shennipratz beqeren zavit mammash lirshut harabbim o lekarmelit, apillu bepachot meeser asur im gam haqqeruy nipratz meal hazzavit, ad shehannishar hu baalakson mikkotel zeh lekotel sheetzlo, sheaz en omerim bo "pi tiqra yored vesotem", lepi shehattaam sheomerim "pi tiqra yored vesotem" hu mishshum sheddomeh lepetach, ubeqeren zavit en derek laasot sham petach kelal. Abal petach sheenah beqeren zavit omerim bah "pi tiqra yored vesotem", apillu hi yetera meeser raq sheenah bemilluah. Veyesh omerim sheapillu hi bemilluah, apillu nipretzu b' mechitztzot zo etzel zo bemilluam venishar qeruy alehem — omerim bo "pi tiqra yored vesotem" im nishar sham b' mechitztzot debuqot zo bezo. Abal im nipretzu b' mechitztzot zo keneged zo bemilluah o beyoter measara, venishar b' mechitztzot shelemot zo keneged zo — kevan sheyyesh benehem pillush veqappandarya mippirtza zo lepirtza shekkenegdah, en omerim bahen "pi tiqra yored vesotem". Veken iqqar. Veap al pi ken tob lachush lisbara harishona, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"v:

Yesh omerim sheen pi tiqra yored vesotem apillu lepirtza shemmeruach echad, ella im ken yesh berochab haqqeruy d' tepachim. Veyesh omerim shetztzarik gam ken shello yehe pi hattiqra meshuppa kegaggin shellanu, sheaz en bahem peh, velo amrinan ella "pi tiqra yored vesotem":
